prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after custom photo upload: Move the sign-in screen to take place after photo upload and pet selection but before the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick friend screen carousel redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen to use a carousel layout featuring dynamic preview components for each pet option.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview_anim", "style": "rounded"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive photo upload checklist flow: Convert photo upload into a guided checklist sub-flow with mascot instructions for custom pet creation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "text": "Follow these simple steps for the best pet creation result!", "style": "playful"}]}}
3: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-waiting pet setup verification screen: Add a new confirmation screen before the waiting screen to display summary details of the adopted pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_pet_summary", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_summary": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready to Hatch!", "body": "Review your pet details before entering your desktop habitat.", "layout": "card"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen ready notification toggle: Enable a system notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
5: [choose_path, layout] Story screen spotlight layout redesign: Update the story screen to a spotlight layout featuring a prominent animated pet hero element.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "spotlight", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:hero_welcome_anim", "style": "large"}]}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption certificate official badge: Add a highlighted founder companion badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Official Founder Companion", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [finish, hint] Home intro desktop controls tray hint: Add text and hint components on the final home intro screen explaining desktop tray access and pet interaction shortcuts.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Access your desktop system tray anytime to control or chat with your pet.", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Tip: Right-click your desktop pet for quick settings and actions.", "style": "subtle"}]}}
8: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen animated companion idle preview: Add an animated hatching pet preview component to the waiting screen while background generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_hatching_idle", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Choose path screen headline copy refresh: Rewrite the choose_path screen headline and body to clearly distinguish preset adoption from custom photo creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Companion Path", "body": "Select a ready-made desktop pet or create a custom pet from your photos."}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in after photo upload is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Redesigning pet selection as a carousel preserves the job of letting the user choose a pet.
Converting photo upload to a checklist sub-flow is an allowed onboarding enhancement.
Adding a new pet summary verification screen inside onboarding is permitted under Rule 4.
Adding notification settings and hints to the waiting screen is permitted by Rule 4.
Redesigning the story screen layout retains its job of introducing the pet.
Replacing the adoption certificate stamp with a founder badge fails to present an official adoption stamp.
Adding desktop tray hints to the home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding an animated preview component to the waiting screen is an allowed modification.
Updating choose_path copy to clarify adoption vs custom creation retains the screen's core job.
